name: What documents do I need to prepare if I decide to sell my home to avoid foreclosure?

mainEntity.name: What documents do I need to prepare if I decide to sell my home to avoid foreclosure?

acceptedAnswer.text: To prepare for selling, you'll need mortgage statements, property tax records, insurance policies, any HOA documents, and a clear understanding of your current loan balance. Gathering these documents early is crucial preparation for your agent and potential buyers. If you are considering a short sale, your lender will also require financial statements, income verification, and a hardship letter explaining why you can no longer afford your payments.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prepare mortgage statements, tax records, insurance, and HOA documents. For a short sale, also gather financial statements and a hardship letter.
